Card Q&A.q: When an effect would delete this Digimon and one of my [Yuu Amano] cards at the same time, does this card’s effect prevent my [Yuu Amano] card from being deleted?

Effect: ＜Decoy ([Bagra Army])＞ (When one of your other Digimon with [Bagra Army] in its traits would be deleted by an opponent's effect, you may delete this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[All Turns] All of your [Yuu Amano] can't be deleted.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [Damemon] from your trash suspended without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] When an effect trashes this card from digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
